text:
Or outside the world. Why?

But what do I answer him,

If the Archangel asks,

In a deep time?


In the world I was passing:

But very far away.

Through dreams and loves

I was disintegrating.


The world did not see:

My permanence

Was, everywhere,

Phantasmagorical.


I gave, but I did not have.

And in that abundance,

Nothing remained for me:

I do not know whether I was mine.


Whether I was in the world

or outside the world?

—Thus I present myself,

If the Archangel asks

My deep name.

translation.title: Or Outside the World. Why?...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the speaker's uncertain existence between world, dream, abundance, and the Archangel's question.
